selection.service_p95_request: Nearest ranked observed call, with earlier offered ordinal first on ties.
selection.own_p95_band: Calls above rank 94% through rank 96%, selected independently within each arm and role.
selection.own_slowest_5pct: Calls strictly above the p95 rank, using rank order to break ties.
selection.same_offers_slowest_5pct_union: The same slot and offered ordinal in both arms, selected if either arm was in its slowest 5%.
selection.phase_gaps: Differences of means over each selection. The phase gaps sum to the selected mean total gap.
